name: Demo Seed Pack
description: Illustrative categories and policies for the Isis factory/demo environment. Initializes a demo scope so a new operator can see how categories, usage instructions, and cross-cutting policies fit together.

scope.name: demo
scope.description: Demo scope showcasing code + writing memory.

categories.name: Filesystem Layout
categories.description: Where things live in the repository.
categories.instructions: Write one memory per project describing the top-level directory layout and what each area owns. Update in place when structure changes.

categories.name: Build & Test Commands
categories.description: How to build, run, and test the project.
categories.instructions: Record the exact commands (build, test, lint, run). Prefer copy-pasteable one-liners. Note prerequisites and expected outputs.

categories.name: Decisions & Rationale
categories.description: Design decisions and why they were made.
categories.instructions: Capture a decision, the alternatives considered, and the reasoning. Link related decisions with [[slug]] references.

policies.name: Commit Message Style
policies.body: Use imperative present tense ("add", not "added"). Keep the subject under 72 characters. Explain the why in the body when non-obvious.

policies.name: Writing Style
policies.body: Prefer plain, direct prose. Avoid filler and hedging. Define acronyms on first use.
